verdict.notes: This is clearly a production insurance application program generated from a skeleton template (BDOSKEL) and subsequently hand-modified. The program was generated in December 2008 and last recompiled in August 2012. The source is truncated to 16000 chars out of ~514KB, so only the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION beginning is visible, but the structural indicators (all 4 divisions present, EXEC SQL, EXEC CICS, 28 CALLs, 304 PERFORMs) confirm a full production BDO program. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being IBM mainframe, which is somewhat unusual but not disqualifying.
